parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Transmission Service (DTS) task. The DTS task can be a data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

>  You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to obtain the task ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

*   **Forward**
*   **Reverse**

> 

*   The default value is **Forward**.

*   You can set this parameter to **Reverse** only if the topology is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Whether it is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) task, the value can be:
- **false**: No. - **true**: Yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts suspend-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts SuspendDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
